description: BM25 retrieval over the curated careers dataset, measured on evals/chat-eval.json. A hit means at least one expected passage is in the top k. Retrieval was tuned on the development split only; the heldout split is the number to trust. The gate rows show how many non-answerable questions retrieval alone rejects; the rest rely on the model abstaining.
